releaseNotes: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder now support a selectable Snooze interval (5/10/15/30 minutes) and repeat limit (off/3/5/10 times). Existing ringtone selection, reminder timing, notification actions, calendar recurrence, notes, photos, PIN data, and app identity remain preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Reminder Snooze controls are ready; update the Diary web bundle after installing the matching APK.
